column1: # The RFC 7529 RSCALE corpus: every case on which ical-rs, built with its
# rscale feature, and libical 3.0.20 built against ICU 76 answer alike. Three
# tab-separated fields: the DTSTART, the RRULE, and up to twelve occurrences,
# One oracle, because only one exists: python-dateutil does not parse RSCALE,
# and libical expands a non-Gregorian scale only through ICU. ical-rs computes
# its calendars through ICU4X instead, so the two share the CLDR algorithms
# Regenerated by harness/rscale.sh. Never edit an expected value by hand.
